summary: Emit fingerprints every local module the program's run loaded; check re-hashes offline and a moved module is one root-level fresh finding
acceptance: Editing a module the program imports, with no input() declared, turns root.fresh on the root member with the re-emit remedy; check runs no Node
tests: emit writes a provenance row for each local module the program loaded
a module under node_modules gets no provenance row
a moved program module is a root level fresh finding with the re emit remedy
an unchanged program module closure reports no fresh finding
notes: Seam change: SDK row builder, Rust reader and generated binding move together (BLESS_SEAM_BINDINGS). Drift's finding shape is pipeline.md "Drift"; input() narrowing is authoring.md "The SDK". How Node reports loaded modules (loader hook, etc.) is build's call. No refusal of an input() naming a TS module is derived: 0080 says one 'can' name it, the spec does not require it.
